notes.title: DanMachi Full Game Available!
notes.content:
Hey Familia,

We hope you're enjoying this mini side-scrolling game! 
In case you hadn't seen, there is also a full game for DanMachi or Is It Wrong to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? - which combines visual novel parts of the anime with dungeon crawling gameplay! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39208372/1d848cfe8a7e8a4e6607dd5f1d97557e2983d88d.gif[/img]

The story is that of the first anime series, and adds the perspective of Aiz, as well as date events in the post-story part of the game

To top it off, it's currently on sale for the Autumn sale with 30% off!

Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1187940/Is_It_Wrong_to_Try_to_Pick_Up_Girls_in_a_Dungeon_Infinite_Combate/]here[/url]! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39208372/c7af2e499219e0405e1df6025a68f79df1324d1f.gif[/img]
